title: Transpose of ordinary reduction is expression completion
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, l,E,o,a and any comparison family satisfying RecursionLaws [def-sf-integral-realization-assembly-data]. Let e be a geometric finite expression and K an object of its domain [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. The adjunction transpose of e.ordinaryReduction [def-sf-integral-ordinary-expression-reduction], followed by the component of the given comparison for e, equals the actual recursively constructed completion map from the ordinary ringed value to the completed value. No pair of expressions or structural generator appears in this assertion.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: induct on the expression. The variable case is inputNormalization. Naturality of each primitive coefficient map substitutes the transpose of the child coefficient map. The quotient augmentation equations identify the pull and tensor transposes. For proper image, the adjoint-conjugate comparison has exactly the transpose of its reduction mate. For open extension, transpose openNormalization and cancel the unit at the good open image; its fixed reduction mate is invertible. Apply the recursion law for the parent comparison, cancel its primitive isomorphism and use the child induction hypothesis. At tensor do this in both slots. Compact support is exactly open extension followed by proper image, with the recorded good open intermediate. No structural generator or pair of expressions is used.

proof_origin.place: Explicit ordinary coefficient recursion and its primitive generator diagrams; refinement of lem-sf-integral-basic-generator-square.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryExpressionNormalization (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    (comparison : ExpressionRecursion.Comparisons l E D o)
    (laws : RecursionLaws l E D o a comparison)
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] {X : I → Over (Spec (.of D.k))}
    {W : Over (Spec (.of D.k))} (e : Expression _ I X W) (g : e.geometric)
    (K : (e.domain l E o).FullSubcategory) :
    ((calculus l E W.left).adjunction.homEquiv _ _)
      (e.ordinaryReduction l E o a K.obj) ≫ (comparison e g).hom.app K =
      e.completionMap l E a.ringedModels K.obj
